name: A10-0142/2026 – Hannah Neumann – § 7 – Am 2
title: REPORT on countering transnational repression – towards an EU strategy to protect Europe’s sovereignty and democratic values
part_text: 7. Stresses that the Member States are currently affected by TNR to differing degrees and display varying levels of awareness, institutional preparedness and protection mechanisms; recalls, however, that while transnational repression constitutes a serious threat and a grave form of foreign interference, it must not be exploited by the EU as a pretext to circumvent the Treaties; recalls that, pursuant to Article 4(2) of the Treaty on European Union, Member States are solely responsible for ensuring their national security;
